messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Graph-Ramsey / hypergraph coloring: enforce large empty triangles by anti-collinearity colorings on a dense carrier set

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "There exists a 13-point configuration in the unit square with all coordinates in the field Q(√5) whose minimum triangle area equals 1/46, obtained by taking the vertices of a regular pentagon inscribed in a circle of radius (√5−1)/2 centered at (1/2,1/2), together with four points at golden-ratio positions on the boundary midlines and four points at positions (i/5, {i·φ}/5) for i=1,2,3,4, where the Q(√5)-rationality of all coordinates enforces a complete 3-uniform hypergraph 2-coloring in which no monochromatic collinear triple exists, guaranteeing every triangle has area bounded below by the algebraic norm of an irrational-area class."}
